text:
mina (People Ops): @here Berlin folks: heads up — the city scheduled an expedited bridge inspection on the footbridge by Mitte next Sat 2026-12-05 which will close the usual shuttle drop-off route. Office access remains open but ground routes 08:00-18:00 will be rerouted.

mina (People Ops): TL;DR: Saturday hack day + demo fair will move to KulturHaus (3 blocks east) 09:00-17:00. We will run alternate shuttle stops & extra bike parking. If you planned to be onsite that day, please read details below and react.

mina (People Ops): What we arranged: 
68C Two alternate shuttle loops (North Stop at Alexanderpl. & South Stop at Oranienburger) 08:15-10:00 and 16:30-18:30.
6B2 Extra bike racks by the KulturHaus entrance.
4DD Reserved community hall at KulturHaus for the hack day (main hall + two breakout rooms).
4B8 Travel stipend: 282 per person for taxi/Uber if you need door-to-door due to mobility concerns (expense code berlin-bridge-26).

olek (Facilities): Quick notes: loading dock at HQ will be closed Sat 06:00-20:00 for inspection staging. Deliveries should be rescheduled to Fri afternoon or routed to KulturHaus vendor area. Vendors use Loading Bay West; we'll provide a pass.

mina (People Ops): Catering: weve moved food to KulturHaus catering area. If you booked hot buffet, vendors will use insulated carriers; label dietary bags clearly. DM me any allergies.

rachel: Im paneling at 11:00 and need AV. Is KulturHaus AV full spec?

olek (Facilities): @rachel KulturHaus has projector + PA. We booked an AV tech 09:00-17:00. If you need specific adapters, bring them or request via this short form: https://forms.company/av-request by Thu EOD.

dan: Im on-call Sat — will I still be able to access server keys if Im at KulturHaus?

security-bot: On-call access policy: registered on-call staff retain VPN and SSH access. For physical key access, Facilities will provide escorted pickup slots Fri 17:00-19:00 or a secured courier to KulturHaus. Submit a quick-access request.

mina (People Ops): Shuttle schedule (approx):
```
Alexanderpl. -> Redwood HQ -> KulturHaus
08:15 depart Alexanderpl., 08:35 arrive HQ, 08:45 arrive KulturHaus
08:45 depart Alexanderpl., 09:05 arrive HQ, 09:15 arrive KulturHaus

KulturHaus -> HQ -> Alexanderpl.
16:30 depart KulturHaus, 16:45 arrive HQ, 17:05 arrive Alexanderpl.
17:30 depart KulturHaus, 17:45 arrive HQ, 18:05 arrive Alexanderpl.
```

mina (People Ops): Accessibility priority: if you need step-free drop-off at KulturHaus or an escorted gear transfer, reply with your name + preferred 30min window. We will prioritize people with mobility needs & heavy equipment.

olek (Facilities): Vendor badges: external guests must check in at KulturHaus reception and show ID. Facilities will pre-register vendors who DM their company name and arrival slot. Badges will be printed on-site.

rachel: Will the usual lactation room be available? I need one midday.

mina (People Ops): We reserved a private lactation room at KulturHaus (Room B) 08:00-18:00. DM me to block a 30min slot. If you prefer HQ, we can reserve the service elevator and lactation suite for 12:00-14:00 but space is limited.

dan: Any change to interview schedules? I had two onsite interviews Sat 10:00-12:00.

mina (People Ops): Please move interviews to virtual or to KulturHaus breakout room 2. If you need People Ops to rebook candidates, reply with names and times and we'll send new invites.

mina (People Ops): Final reminders: react with :white_check_mark: if youre attending the hack day in person, :bicycle: if you plan to bike, or DM for taxi stipend. Well publish final shuttle passcodes Fri 18:00.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Berlin - Bridge Inspection (Hack Day moved to KulturHaus)" 2026-12-05. Location: KulturHaus (fallback from HQ).

olek (Facilities): Facilities contact for the event: Olek M. (ext 621). For urgent day-of issues call +49-30-555-0162.

mina (People Ops): Thanks all 60A We appreciate flexibility — the goal is to keep the event fun and accessible even with the detour. Will post a final logistics note Fri evening.

rachel: Appreciate the alternate venue 44D
